summary: Add a network-install ISO using direct Debian and Fedora downloads and Nex-only release payloads, with matching forge build workflows

guide.reason: Operators choose full or network installation, configure internet access and recover from unavailable or invalid downloads.

api.reason: Local wizard, Debian Installer, build and release tooling change; no Controller operation, Core command, observed-state or client-facing API contract changes.

roadmap.reason: An additional installation variant does not promote a platform milestone or close its acceptance gates.

state.reason: No new pool or Controller-owned state; existing installer settings continue into host configuration and the package database.

verification.method: Local automated checks, independent review and clean final-artifact BIOS installation/first boot/reboot for both ISO variants passed; UEFI installation, hardware and hosted forge/publication limits are recorded in the QA report.
